findings: Author source uses Python2.7/Keras2.1.2 text CNN with independent sigmoid outputs and binary cross entropy; repository LICENSE is MIT.
Class cutoffs fit mirrored positive training scores p and 2-p with Gaussian maximum-likelihood standard deviation.
Paper uses alpha3 and rejects iff all class scores are below their own thresholds; example code uses scale1 and tests only the argmax class, rejecting equality.
Paper/source differences also include pretrained embeddings and sequence length; repository README explicitly disclaims full reproduction without original embeddings and repeated class splits.
